title: On the post-hoc Evaluation of PDE Discovery: A Multifaceted Challenge of Scientific Advancement
abstract: arXiv:2607.23753v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: PDE discovery aims to identify from data the governing law of a physical system. Constituting a cornerstone of scientific advancement, it has become during the past decade a major line of research in the rapidly evolving field of Physics-informed Machine Learning (PiML). Among the open problems to address in this domain, the post-hoc evaluation of discovered PDEs raises the particular difficulty of being multifaceted. Indeed, it requires jointly considering predictive accuracy, physical consistency, interpretability, and out-of-distribution generalization capacity, some of these properties being conflicting. Drawing on an extensive body of literature spanning ML, numerical analysis and symbolic regression, we establish in this article that the overwhelming majority of papers address only certain aspects of the overall evaluation task. translated_title: 关于偏微分方程发现的事后评估：科学进步的多方面挑战
translated_abstract: 偏微分方程（PDE）发现旨在从数据中识别物理系统的控制定律。作为科学进步的基石，在过去十年中，它已成为快速发展的物理信息机器学习（PiML）领域的一条主要研究方向。在该领域有待解决的开放性问题中，已发现PDE的事后评估尤为困难，因为它是多方面的。事实上，该评估需要同时考虑预测准确性、物理一致性、可解释性以及分布外泛化能力，而其中某些属性之间是相互冲突的。基于跨越机器学习、数值分析和符号回归等领域的大量文献，我们在本文中论证了绝大多数论文仅涉及整体评估任务中的某些方面。为了更好地理解这些方法在彼此割裂使用时的局限性，我们提出了首个（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文指出PDE发现的事后评估是一个多方面的挑战，需要综合权衡预测准确性、物理一致性、可解释性与分布外泛化能力，而现有绝大多数论文仅关注其中部分方面。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes that the post-hoc evaluation of PDE discovery is a multifaceted challenge requiring the joint consideration of predictive accuracy, physical consistency, interpretability, and out-of-distribution generalization, yet the vast majority of existing papers address only certain aspects of this task.
